caption:
This drawing consists of an embroidered or stitched sampler on a tan fabric background, bordered by a repeating geometric pattern of alternating orange and red diamond shapes connected by a green line. Inside the border, there is a symmetrical arrangement of various colorful flowers, vines, and leaves in shades of green, red, blue, purple, yellow, and pink, with some cross motifs incorporated among the floral elements. In the bottom center, there is a blue and white checkerboard-patterned vase, from which the floral arrangement appears to be emerging. Near the top and within the floral motifs, the date "1837" is stitched in red. Below the date, a four-line poem is stitched in dark blue:

"When youth’s soft seasons o’er
And childhood charms no more
My riper years shall gladly see,
This proof of early industry"

Near the bottom, just above the vase, the name "Salina VanWorme" and the phrase "Aged 14 years" are stitched in dark blue. The entire composition is framed by a thin red-brown border representative of the frame that is visible in the image.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
